segments.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 realistic phone-shot US laundry UGC video. Use the supplied reference images as the only product design authority. Product lock: exactly one single floating washing-machine lint filter, a white circular outer rim, exactly four sky-blue rounded float domes with one central dome and three outer domes, white three-spoke support structure, and one long pointed cone-shaped fine white mesh bag. Never show more than one filter or alter its shape, colors, dome count, rim, supports, or mesh length. Bright ordinary American laundry room with a white top-loading washing machine. 0-3s: close-up, a young adult American woman in casual home clothes gently pinches a few loose hairs and lint from a freshly washed pale shirt, looking mildly frustrated; this is realistic, not dramatic. 3-6s: hard cut, she shows one exact filter beside the open top-loading washer and lowers it into the wash water with laundry. 6-10s: close low-angle washer view; the single white ring and four blue domes float naturally at the water surface while the long tapered mesh cone hangs downward, with laundry moving gently below. Natural laundry-room ambience. Natural female US English voice-over: Still picking loose hair and lint off clean clothes? I drop this little floating filter in with the wash to catch what is floating around. No subtitles, captions, text overlays, logos, labels, watermarks, UI, arrows, stickers, pricing, magical suction, oversized debris, or exaggerated cleaning claims.
segments.negative_prompt: multiple filters, washing ball, drain strainer, fixed filter, buttons, handles, text, logos, false product features, cartoon, deformed hands, impossible water physics
